controls.label: Shape
controls.description: The shared grid marks unavailable surface imagery on this radar model. The north pole was not covered by the radar images, so its topography and flattening depend on modeling constraints. The pole is uncertain by 10 degrees and equivalent diameter is 400 ± 50 m. The unmodified archive mesh is retained; no resolved optical surface map is supplied. Lighting uses the published pole and arbitrary display phase.
controls.title: Radar shape model

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: False color shows radius at the nearest source-surface point minus a 0.2 km reference sphere. It includes global shape, not gravitational height or independent measured topography. Correspondence farther than 5 m is withheld. The north pole was not covered by the radar images, so its topography and flattening depend on modeling constraints. The pole is uncertain by 10 degrees and equivalent diameter is 400 ± 50 m. The unmodified archive mesh is retained; no resolved optical surface map is supplied.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
